Name: Raccoon to Tanuki
Author: fraymotif
Description:
This is my first mod! 

Just an appearance mod for those who want to add some pom poko goodness to their valley life. 

Please let me know if you encounter any issues as I have not completed the questline yet to test all sprites. 

[color=#e69138][size=4][b]HOW TO USE
[/b][/size][/color]1. Install SMAPI and ﻿Content Patcher. 
2. Download Raccoon to Tanuki and unzip. You should get a "[CP] Raccoon to Tanuki" folder. 
3. Drag "[CP] Raccoon to Tanuki" folder to your SMAPI mods folder (the same folder as where the Content Patcher folder is). 
4. Run the game.
